Fixed: 1.3.32 could keep the game on its loading screen forever at start (its new disk writer waited on a thread Windows doesn't let run until the game has loaded). Reported by gango90 and GodWhat420.
Settings > Advanced > Tint Strength, under Level Areas: how strongly the level areas' colours cover the map, 10% to 80% (50% as before). The borders and the level badges stay as they are. Requested by dremen.
Fixed: with Region Filter on, the check marks on Flame and Night Sanctums you've been to (and the height arrows on player graves) stayed outside the regions shown. They now hide and dim with their icon. Reported by izisot.
Bosses: the Vukah Brawler camps that showed as just "Boss" now have their name.
Map data updated for the 2 November game patch: its new Vukah Brawler camp, and the few plant and material spots it moved.
